correctness.rationale: The EMA formula, limiting mode matrix, determinant \(\beta_1\), trace, Jury stability frontier, and flat-curvature expansion all reconstruct correctly. But the final theorem includes the plateau boundary with \(\lambda_i\ge\varepsilon\chi_-/\eta\) and calls every such mode a complex-conjugate pair. At equality, the floor branch gives exactly \(\chi_i=\chi_-\); by the package's own discriminant condition \(T_i^2<4\beta_1\), equality has zero discriminant and a repeated real root \(\sqrt{\beta_1}\), not a nonreal conjugate pair. The supplied verifier also avoids asserting nonzero imaginary part exactly at the threshold. The rate modulus remains correct at equality, but the stated root-type claim is false on an explicitly included boundary, so the submitted final claim fails correctness.
